summary: Bread Financial Holdings filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of depositary shares, each representing a 1/40th interest in a share of its Series B Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a liquidation preference of $25 per depositary share ($1,000 per preferred share). No specific offering size or price was stated. Dividends are non-cumulative, reset after December 15, 2031, based on the Five-Year U.S. Treasury Rate plus a spread. The company may redeem the shares optionally on or after the first reset date. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
